compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. One out-of-line destructor under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1, D0, then D2. The cartridge has D1 at ov002:0x020ec56c and D0 at 0x020ec5b4 and no D2. Production isolation discards it. It is emitted after D0, and the licensed functions stay ROM-ascending.

include/types.h defines Vector3::~Vector3() inline and empty. Several helpers take Vector3 locals, so this TU emits that four-byte body once as vague linkage. The cartridge's copy is arm9:0x020072c0 (src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp); this object is not its home.

The out-of-line destructor is the key function, so this TU emits the vtable. ov002:0x0210adb4 is in .data, outside the licensed text span 0x020ec56c..0x020ee42c. D1, D0 and the factory store this vptr; text-only production discards the emitted copy and retains cartridge data.
This class's __si_class_type_info, dragged in with the vtable. Cartridge copy ov002:0x0210ad84. Its base word is _ZTI12dEnemyBase_c.
